title: Atlas
description: Your pages, databases and ideas, connected.
welcomeBody: Every page is part of a bigger picture. Select a node to read, trace its connections, and discover what comes next.
linkTipBody: Mention another page in your editor. Atlas brings those connections into the map automatically.
exploreTipBody: Drag nodes to arrange your map. Scroll to zoom. Double-click a node to open its original page.
previewError: The page preview could not be loaded.
emptyPage: This page is a blank canvas. Open it to start writing.
previewTruncated: Preview shortened. Open the page to read everything.
removePrompt: Remove this connection? Both pages will stay.
offline: You are offline. Connections are read-only until you reconnect.
limited: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} pages. Search or filter to explore the rest.
selectedFiltered: The selected page is outside the current filters.
emptyBody: Create your first page, or add items to a workspace database. Link them in the editor and watch your map take shape.
unresolved: {{count}} page links could not be resolved. Create or correct their targets in the editor.
workspaceUnavailable: This workspace is unavailable or you no longer have access.

layers.title: Connection layers
layers.help: Context links are suggestions from shared text or indexed embeddings. Higher similarity keeps only closer matches.
layers.unavailable: Context discovery is unavailable. Saved links are still available.
layers.coverage: Context analyzed {{count}} of {{total}} sources; large maps use bounded topic and tag discovery.

evidence.title: Why these connect
evidence.tag: An explicit tag connects these items.
evidence.topic: This recurring phrase appears in the connected sources.
evidence.lexical: These sources share meaningful words and phrases. This is an inferred connection.
evidence.embedding: Fresh embeddings in your RAG index suggest related meaning. This is an inferred connection.
evidence.tagHub: A shared tag brings items together across your workspace. Change tags in the original pages or database items.
evidence.topicHub: A topic discovered from recurring words and phrases in your content. These links are suggestions, not manually saved relationships.

rag.title: Search knowledge
rag.placeholder: Explore an idea, question or topic…
rag.help: Workspace evidence from your existing RAG search.
rag.fallback: Some model services are unavailable; available evidence is retained
rag.empty: No matching evidence. Try a different phrase.

dashboard.perspective: Step back. See what connects. Make room for your next idea.
dashboard.layerHint: Keep the overview quiet. Add topics or context when you want to look deeper.
dashboard.trailsHint: Explore the most connected parts of this view.
dashboard.sharedContent: Uses the same saved pages and database items as the rest of your workspace.
dashboard.databaseHelp: Open a collection in Databases, or explore its items and inline views on the map.
dashboard.emptyDatabases: Databases you create in this workspace appear here automatically.
